title: Five years at the bench.
text: I am a Microbiology graduate of Primeasia University (CGPA 3.63/4.00) and a Medical Laboratory Technologist at Islami Bank Hospital and Cardiac Centre, Mirpur. Across three hospitals in Dhaka I have worked in microbiology, hematology, biochemistry, immunology, molecular testing and transfusion medicine. Daily contact with clinical specimens has shaped my research questions, especially on antibiotic resistance and transfusion safety.

cards.title: Research Interests
items: Antimicrobial resistance — resistance patterns in clinical isolates and antimicrobial stewardship
Clinical microbiology — pathogen identification and susceptibility testing
Molecular diagnostics — PCR-based detection in routine laboratory practice
Transfusion medicine — red cell alloimmunization in transfusion-dependent patients

cards.title: Academic Goal
cards.text: To advance my academic knowledge through postgraduate study and conduct research that improves public health.
cards.note: Seeking: MSc / PhD and research positions in microbiology and laboratory medicine

cards.title: Languages
cards.note: Strengths: quality control, teamwork, communication, training junior staff
